description: Submission of the Registration and Licensing of Medicines (fees) Regulations, No.02 of 2017, as amended for approval of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, No.5 of 2015, provides for the Minister in charge of the subject to make Regulations in respect of the procedure and the manner in which any medicine, medical device or borderline product should be registered, the terms and conditions applicable to such registration and licensing, and the fees to be charged for such registration or licensing. It has been found necessary to revise the Registration and Licensing of Medicines (fees) Regulations due to the reasons such as, changes in economic and financial values ​​that have occurred in Sri Lanka after 2019, the introduction of new technologies and testing methods, the expansion of the range of regulatory services, the maintenance of transparency of the National Medicines Regulatory Authority and the protection of international equivalence. Accordingly, measures have been taken to publish the Registration and Licensing of Medicines (fees) Regulations, No.02 of 2017, as amended, published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2023/30 dated 2017‑06‑14 by further amending the same, having published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2452/39 dated 2025-09-04. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to submit the said amended Regulation as per the provisions of the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act No. 5 of 2015, to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
